value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Patterson/Stanislaus County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value: Call the 24-hour recorder at (209) 895-8028, providing the permit number, project address, inspection type, callback number, and AM (8-12) or PM (1-5) preference
Requests made before 3:00pm are scheduled for the next business day; requests made after 3:00pm are scheduled for the second business day following the call
Approved plans and the permit envelope must be on the job site when the inspector arrives
inspection_steps.notes: Directly confirmed via the City's own 'Inspection Request Procedure' handout. This is the City's general Building Division inspection process (covers all permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence. Replaces a prior lower-confidence entry.

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Rooftop Solar Permitting Procedures (municipal code Ch. 15.59, per Government Code §65850.5)
other_conditions: Systems must be no larger than 10kW AC nameplate (or 30kW thermal) and installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling to qualify for expedited, streamlined permitting
